messages:
maria: heads-up 5) the Dedicated provisioning guide's SDK examples still show a single `labels` map. that caused confusion in a customer proof-of-concept where reserved-pool bindings silently overrode tenant intent. can we clarify precedence and surface the newer API shape?

samir: agree. short summary: pool binding labels are authoritative during allocation; tenant labels are merged for downstream policy checks. we added explicit args last quarter (`binding_labels` and `tenant_labels`) but the docs weren't updated.

elaine: ugh. i noticed this when editing the autoscale page: links to the isolation section fail because the header was moved. i'll fix anchors as part of the doc pass. also we should include a tiny decision table for mobile readers.

maria: sample decision table idea: rows for (only tenant labels), (binding + tenant labels), (conflict on reserved_tier). keeps it to 2-3 bullets each.

kevin: also add a short go snippet. current go example has the old `Labels map[string]string` param. new should be something like: ```go
client.CreateReservedCapacity(ctx, CreateReservedCapacityParams{
    TenantID: "acct-123",
    TenantLabels: map[string]string{"env":"prod","priority":"standard"},
    BindingLabels: map[string]string{"reserved_tier":"gold"},
    ReservedPool: "gpu-pool-1",
})
```

samir: another practical example: show preemption + surge fallback interplay. customers get surprised when preempted workloads route to fallback models and lose KV cache. snippet: ```yaml
routing:
  - when: pool_preempted
    to: model:opt-6b-quant
    preserve_kv_cache: false
  - when: pool_saturated
    to: model:llama-7b-quant
    preserve_kv_cache: true
```

maria: can someone open a PR that does: update python + go SDK snippets, add the label precedence subsection, tiny decision table, YAML fallback example, and anchor fixes? also add a tiny rendering test that asserts the anchor exists.

elaine: i'll file the PR. scheduling: i'll work on it after lunch and add a CI markdown render test that fails if anchor missing. will also update the handbook TOC reference.

kevin: ping infra for an automated link check when PR is up: @dev-docs-bot can you queue link-check on the branch? :mag:  
dev-docs-bot: link-check queued for branch/patch/provisioning-labels-176111. results will be posted here.

maria: thanks. aim: PR today, merge tomorrow after a quick review. i'll write a short blurb for release notes to call out the API sample update.

samir: i'll notify SDK owners to ensure the reference page documents `binding_labels`. small follow-up: add a note about evaluation ordering (allocation -> routing -> fallback).

elaine: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4312 contains the snippets, table, anchor fix, and the yaml example. added a tiny render test under docs/tests/test_render_anchor.py. PTAL.

kevin: left two micro nits on wording. approved post-fix.

maria: merged. deployed docs site. verified anchor works.

dev-docs-bot: link-check complete 5) 1 fixed anchor, 0 remaining broken links. report: https://ci.internal/reports/176111-linkcheck (internal)

samir: logging a KB update for support and sent a note to solutions engineering with sample tenant/pool combos. ticket: KB-9921.

maria: great work. archiving this thread after release note publish. :thumbsup:
